candidates.exact_span: The description, including procedures followed, and results of the Paint Filter Tests performed.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether this clause imposes a required Paint Filter Test monitoring/reporting obligation (versus merely describing optional or historical testing) changes which monitoring requirements are marked required or unresolved for FY2025, and how missing Paint Filter Test results are classified under missing-evidence semantics.

candidates.exact_span: The description, including procedures followed, and results of the TCLP Test.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether this clause requires TCLP testing and reporting (and on what schedule) affects applicability of TCLP monitoring obligations and whether absent TCLP descriptions/results are documented no-data, not-required, or inadequate-evidence cases.

candidates.exact_span: 9. Reporting requirements - The permittee shall report annually on the Discharge Monitoring Report the following information:
candidates.computation_change_reason: The annual DMR reporting mandate and scope of 'the following information' govern which sludge-related items are required each Federal FY2025 monitoring period; different readings of frequency or DMR attachment scope change required-vs-not-required determinations and missing-report classifications.

candidates.exact_span: Results of the Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure Test conducted on the sludge to be disposed (Pass/Fail).
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpreting Pass/Fail as an enforceable compliance criterion versus report-only monitoring changes whether Purpose A performs a limit comparison; it also fixes a specific annual DMR reporting obligation (Purpose B) and determines how absent Pass/Fail results are treated when no numeric measurement exists (Purpose C).

candidates.exact_span: Annual sludge production in dry metric tons/year.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether this establishes a mandatory annual quantity report on the DMR affects monitoring/reporting applicability for FY2025 and whether missing production data is a required-but-unreported case versus a non-operative or unresolved no-data state.

candidates.exact_span: Amount of sludge disposed in a municipal solid waste landfill in dry metric tons/year.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Applicability of this annual disposal-quantity reporting requirement depends on interpretation of disposal activity and units; that changes which FY2025 periods require the report and how missing disposal amounts are categorized.

candidates.exact_span: Amount of sludge transported interstate in dry metric tons/year.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether interstate transport triggers a separate annual reporting obligation (and when transport counts as interstate) affects which monitoring requirements apply and whether absent transport data reflects not-required transport, documented no-discharge/no-transport, or missing required evidence.

candidates.exact_span: A certification that sewage sludge meets the requirements in 40 CFR 258 concerning the quality of the sludge disposed in a municipal solid waste landfill unit shall be attached to the DMR.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Linking sludge quality to 40 CFR 258 and requiring DMR attachment can be read as invoking external enforceable quality limits (affecting limit applicability/comparison) or as a standalone certification/reporting duty; it also sets a monitoring-evidence obligation whose absence may be unresolved missing certification versus conditional non-applicability when no landfill disposal occurs.
